answer_1.quote: In the field of Natural Language Generation (NLG), the quality of generated text is crucial, influencing the usability and effectiveness of applications ranging from automated reporting to conversational agents.
answer_1.outputs: coherent and contextually relevant natural language texts

answer_2.quote: We use reference-based automated metrics primarily to assess the degree to which our seq2seq model ... learns to match the kinds of texts present in the corpora... We report BLEU as implemented in SacreBLEU for a discrete word-overlap metric and rescaled BERTScore F1 for a slightly more flexible quality metric.

answer_4.quote: We asked participants to assess fluency and semantic fidelity... We recruited 36 participants for each dataset through Prolific.
answer_4.guideline: Participants rated fluency on a 7-point Likert scale and assessed semantic fidelity by indicating whether input elements were present, missing, or incorrect using a table of subjects, predicates, and objects.
